messages:
Incident Bot: [ALERT] service: inference-api /v1/generate - sustained 5xx spike in us-west-2, 15m avg error rate 7.8% - routing policy tripped
Ava M.: paging oncall: @Samir K., @Priya R. — creating emergency bridge now :rotating_light:
Samir K.: I'm on it, joining bridge (zoom.us/j/1234) — can someone post a quick impact snapshot?
Priya R.: looking at logs, appears NACKs coming from model runtime when sequence_len > 2048. spinning a debug worker, tailing logs now.
Priya R.: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:01Z runtime ERROR kvcache miss overflow
2026-03-15T14:02:02Z model WARN request dropped due to OOM on device:g4dn.xlarge
```
Samir K.: switching routing to fallback-model-quantized for new requests in us-west-2, hold on: applying policy change (policy id: route-ephemeral-042)
Oncall Bot: Routing policy updated by Samir K. — fallback-model-quantized now active in region us-west-2 :white_check_mark:
Liam (CS Ops): quick heads up — CS triage: 3 paying customers reporting errors (Acme Co, BetaApps, Finlytics). Acme is seeing intermittent failures on user-facing inference calls.
Elena S.: drafting note for status page: short blurb + ETA; will hand off for approval once we confirm stabilization.
Marco D.: can we avoid full rollback? if quantized variant keeps quality we should keep it. also check autoscaler logs for a burst of long sequences.
Priya R.: autoscaler shows a spike in bursty seq_len around 13:58, likely batch mixing causing big KV cache allocations. I've disabled cross-batching for 10m for affected workers.
Ava M.: timeline so far: 13:56 alert -> 13:59 fallback routing -> 14:05 disabled cross-batching -> 14:12 error rate dropped to 0.9%
Samir K.: confirmed stabilization, error rate back under 1% for 10m. good containment.
Liam (CS Ops): sending customer note: short "we saw elevated errors, mitigation applied, follow-up RCA to come". tagging account reps.
Elena S.: status page draft: "We detected increased errors for inference requests in us-west-2 affecting a subset of traffic. We routed affected requests to a fallback model and applied config changes. Service is currently stable. A detailed update will follow." want signoff from @Ava M.
Ava M.: signoff given. post to status page now when you publish. include link to bridge notes. :thumbsup:
Oncall Bot: Incident marked as "mitigated" by Samir K. — recording incident-id: INC-2026-03-15-198999
Samir K.: quick ops checklist for post-incident: 1) collect profiler dumps from affected workers, 2) save autoscaler and batching configs, 3) snapshot model binaries and quantization params, 4) schedule postmortem.
Priya R.: attaching quick debug commands for artifact collection:
```
# collect traces
ssh worker-12 'sudo tar -czf /tmp/traces.tgz /var/log/runtime /opt/inference/traces'
# save autoscaler
curl -sS -X GET "https://infra-api/local/autoscaler/config?env=us-west-2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" > autoscaler-usw2.json
```
Ava M.: postmortem scheduling: propose Monday 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC (60m) — attendees: eng-runtime, eng-sre, eng-ml, cs. Any conflicts?
Marco D.: I'm good. Will bring kernel selection analysis.
Priya R.: available. I'll provide root-cause notes and mitigation steps.
Elena S.: CS / comms rep will attend for customer timeline and template.
Liam (CS Ops): will coordinate customer RCA share and suggested messaging. propose shared doc by EOD tomorrow.
Samir K.: agreed. action items to track in tracker:
- A1: collect worker traces and logs (owner: Priya R., due: 2026-03-16 02:00 UTC)
- A2: produce autoscaler & batching replay to reproduce (owner: Marco D., due: 2026-03-17 00:00 UTC)
- A3: validate quantized fallback correctness on key prompts (owner: eng-ml sprint team, due: 2026-03-18)
- A4: customer comms draft + statuspage post (owner: Elena S. / Liam, due: 2026-03-15 18:00 UTC)
Ava M.: I'll create the incident tracker card and link it here once created. please add short log pointers in the ticket.
Oncall Bot: New incident card created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-198999 - please add attachments and tag labels: "postmortem-scheduled" "customer-impact"
Liam (CS Ops): customer follow-ups plan: immediate status page + direct emails to impacted accounts (template ready), then share RCA doc after postmortem. request account-specific timelines for enterprise customers.
Elena S.: drafted customer email snippet: "We experienced intermittent inference errors earlier today; mitigation applied and service is stable. We will share a root cause analysis and remediation plan by Mon 16:00 UTC. If you saw any data loss or unexpected outputs, please reply and we will prioritize." thoughts?
Ava M.: looks good. add contact link for urgent escalations.
Samir K.: final note — we'll keep rollback off for now; prefer config & batching fixes + model fallback. If we see regression, we'll re-evaluate. Closing bridge in 15m, handoff to post-incident owners. Thanks all. :heart:
Priya R.: closing logs attached to ticket; will push trace tarball to incident card shortly.
Liam (CS Ops): I'll do the initial customer pings and post the statuspage update now. Marking customer comms as in-progress.
Elena S.: published status page update and emailed impacted accounts. linking updates to incident card.
Ava M.: last call for any remaining notes before we move to post-incident cadence — otherwise we'll reconvene at the scheduled postmortem.
Samir K.: nothing else from me. great work, team.
Oncall Bot: Bridge closed by Samir K. - duration 01:12:07 - incident state moved to "post-incident"
